name: goldsky
description: Index and stream onchain data for the questions finance teams actually ask: proof-of-reserves and circulating supply, stablecoin transfer and sanctions monitoring, deposit detection, cross-chain settlement tracking (CCTP), payment reconciliation, wallet balances and transaction history, tokenized assets and RWA holder registries, and prediction-market data including Polymarket fills, positions and PnL. Real-time pipelines, hosted subgraphs, and managed RPC across 150+ chains.

interface.longDescription:
Index and stream onchain data for the questions finance teams actually ask: proof-of-reserves and circulating supply, stablecoin transfer and sanctions monitoring, deposit detection, cross-chain settlement tracking (CCTP), payment reconciliation, wallet balances and transaction history, tokenized assets and RWA holder registries, and prediction-market data including Polymarket fills, positions and PnL. Real-time pipelines, hosted subgraphs, and managed RPC across 150+ chains.

The skills install the Goldsky CLI with npm into user-writable directories and sign in through `goldsky login` in the browser. Requires a desktop environment with Node.js and npm, and a Goldsky account, which can be created during login.
capabilities: Set up Edge and Boost RPC endpoints
